seeded.description: The change adds maxChangedTestContracts = 24 and .slice(0, maxChangedTestContracts) in collectChangedTestContracts, silently dropping every detected changed test contract after the first 24 (declarations/evidence lost). rr-contract-scope.commitMessage: refactor: simplify recent test contract collection

seeded.description: collectLatestCommitContracts no longer filters latest-commit contracts to those inside the PR comparison, so tests from the merged target branch or restored baseline declarations can enter changedTestContracts (tests "merged target tests do not become changed contracts, including in a changed file" and "restored baseline declarations do not enter changed contracts through latest-commit priority" fail).

mergePriorityDiffEvidence now diffs the priority commit against its own parent instead of the current base...head comparison, so prioritized evidence can carry stale line coordinates or files outside the PR (test "priority evidence keeps current head locations after target-branch insertions" fails).

rr-analysis-rule.commitMessage: refactor: streamline analysis rule intent detection

seeded.description: The change removes the requirement that analysis-rule QA be backed by direct changed-line rule evidence (isDirectAnalysisRuleEvidence / rule-evaluation syntax check): any edit in a file whose role is analysis-rule (e.g. read instrumentation or a counter) is now treated as a rule change, creating false analysis-rule lifecycle/scenarios and citing a non-rule line. Tests "analysis file context does not turn instrumentation into rule changes" and "mixed analysis and instrumentation changes cite the rule rather than a preceding counter" fail.

pf-calcom-signup.commitMessage: fix: defer email validation to after first blur on signup form
qaExpectations: Initial typing must not show an invalid-email error
Leaving (blurring) an incomplete/invalid email must show the error
Correcting the value after the first blur must clear the error (revalidation stays responsive)
Form submission must still validate all fields

pf-preferences.commitMessage: feat: submit notification preferences, persist the selected timezone, and show the saved state after the request completes
qaExpectations: Submitting preferences sends the request and the saved state is shown only after the request completes
The selected timezone is persisted and restored (reload / re-entry shows the stored value, stale state recovery)
Request failure, timeout or retry handling (no false saved state)

pf-async-job.commitMessage: feat: persist the asynchronous job lifecycle
qaExpectations: Asynchronous lifecycle ordering: job state transitions are persisted in order (queued/running/completed or failed)
Result delivery: the final result/status is delivered/readable after completion, including failure state
